google-slides.hint: File → Share → Publish to web → Embed
google-slides.step_1: Open your deck and choose File → Share → Publish to web.
google-slides.step_2: Switch to the Embed tab and click Publish.
google-slides.step_3: Copy the iframe embed code and paste it here.

canva.step_1: Above the editor, click Share → More.
canva.step_2: Choose Embed and confirm (this makes the design public).
canva.step_3: Copy the HTML embed code and paste it here.

powerpoint.hint: PowerPoint for the web → File → Share → Embed
powerpoint.step_1: Save the deck to OneDrive, then open it in PowerPoint for the web.
powerpoint.step_2: Choose File → Share → Embed and pick your dimensions.
powerpoint.step_3: Copy the iframe embed code and paste it here. We size the player ourselves.

keynote.step_1: Click Collaborate and set access to Anyone with the link · View only.
keynote.step_2: Copy the iCloud link, then get the embed code for your website.
keynote.step_3: Paste the iframe embed code here.

figma.hint: Share a Figma Slides file and copy the embed
figma.step_1: Open your Figma Slides file and enable link sharing.
figma.step_2: Copy the embed code for the /slides or /deck file.
figma.step_3: Paste the iframe embed code here.

prezi.step_1: From the dashboard, open Share on your presentation.
prezi.step_2: Click Embed and copy the code.
prezi.step_3: Paste the iframe embed code here.

pitch.step_1: Click Share → Share externally and create a public link.
pitch.step_2: Open the link Options (⋯) and choose Copy embed code.
pitch.step_3: Paste the iframe embed code here.

gamma.hint: Share → enable public access → copy iframe
gamma.step_1: Open Share and toggle Allow public access.
gamma.step_2: Copy the generated iframe embed code.
gamma.step_3: Paste the iframe embed code here.

slideshare.step_1: Open the public deck on slideshare.net.
slideshare.step_2: Click Share under the viewer and open the Embed tab.
slideshare.step_3: Copy the iframe embed code and paste it here.

beautiful.hint: Sharing Settings → Public → Get Embed Code
beautiful.step_1: Open Sharing Settings and switch the deck to Public.
beautiful.step_3: Paste the iframe embed code here.

employees.title: Employees
employees.subtitle: Manage employee accounts, activation and learning access.
employees.name: Full name
employees.roles_hint: A person can hold several roles. Leave all unchecked for a regular employee. Anyone with direct reports automatically sees their team's training.
employees.form_hint: Employee code and email are permanent identifiers. Employees set their own password through an activation email.
employees.search: Search by name, code or email
employees.import_hint: Upload CSV or XLSX with employeeCode, fullname and email. Optional: department, jobTitle, managerCode, startDate (YYYY-MM-DD). Maximum 1,000 rows and 5 MB. Imported accounts receive the Employee role.

employees.preview: Review validation results. Only valid rows will be created.

employees.contact_hr: Accounts are provided by HR. Open your activation email or contact the training administrator.

employees.empty_hint: Add your first employee or adjust the filters to find the people you need.

departments.title: Departments
departments.description: One department list shared by employees, assignments and reports. Names are normalized on entry, so case and spacing differences are the same department.
departments.merge_hint: Renaming a department to another department's name merges them. Only departments without employees can be deleted.
departments.merged: Merged into the department with that name

enrollment.due_none_hint: Learners can finish at their own pace.
